boulderRoll.reason: Clean alpha, no rectangle or fringe. Faceted painterly rock with a ghost trail reads as a rolling boulder and is far better than the shipped woven disc.

hurlRock.reason: Rock and dust smear read as a thrown rock and beat shipped, but a thin pale octagonal outline ring hugs the rock and reads as a halo or key fringe at 2x. The dust trail is too dark and muddy, close to the rock tone.
hurlRock.fix: Erode alpha 1px, then decontaminate the edge by pulling RGB from 2px inside (or despill toward the rock's mid-tone) so the light ring disappears. Lift the dust trail value about 15 percent and soften its alpha falloff so it separates from the rock.
